Own array lifecycle including firmware and OS upgrades, controller and drive replacements, and Dell support cases through to closure. Plan and execute storage migrations and array-based replication with minimal disruption to workloads. Serve as technical lead during storage-impacting incidents, coordinating with clients, internal teams, and vendor support. Automate recurring work such as provisioning, reporting, and health checks using scripting and array APIs. Automation ability using AI tooling, scripting (PowerShell, Python, or an equivalent), and direct work against array APIs. Experience writing formal root cause analyses and working inside a structured change management process. Experience with another enterprise array vendor and with environments governed by compliance standards such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, or TPN.
